title: Villars to Polignac, camp of Arleux, 1 Jun 1710 (copy), BL Add MS 61575 f. 44

plaintext.source: Not in Villars' Mémoires (Vogüé) iii appendix, which prints his letters to Polignac of 24 May and 28 June 1710 only.

transcription.source: DECODE DOC_8756 transcription checked against the images; two corrections (575 -> 515; '_' is an underline)
transcription.notes: A copy; clear opening and close; values 3-560.

system.summary: A numerical code of values 3-560 (173 groups, 106 types, group 340 x10), different from the code of Torcy's letter in the same volume.
system.sibling_key: None found: Tomokiyo 11B (Desmarets 1710) and R8768 ruled out
system.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from geertruidenberg (one key per entry). Too short to establish the code type beyond numerical code; only two keys were applied to it.

prior_solution.where: None found: Tomokiyo (blencowe2.htm, 2024) lists it as undeciphered; not in Villars' Mémoires (Vogüé) iii

conditions.human_role: Selected the target; supplied the DECODE login cookie.

solution.what: Sought the ciphertext: Tomokiyo's files 404, DECODE images need login (thumbnail only), BL volume not digitised.
Fetched with the cookie the DECODE images of R8756 (2) and its DOC transcription (Tomokiyo's, the file his dead link pointed to), with the neighbour records R8746-R8774.
Checked the DOC transcription against the images: 575 -> 515 and a false gap (an underline).
Prior-solution check: Tomokiyo's blencowe2.htm unchanged (undeciphered), web search found no edition or decipherment.
Applied Tomokiyo's 11B table (Desmarets 4 June 1710 code, ~190 values): 41/173 groups covered, nonsense; the top group 340 absent.
Checked R8768 (marquis de Rose code, 1715-18 Jacobite names, DE=12): the letter has no 12.
Villars' Mémoires (Vogüé) iii appendix print his letters to Polignac of 24 May and 28 June 1710 and to Voysin of 1 June, not this letter.
173 groups, 106 types, IC 0.0089: too short for a ciphertext-only attack on a code of 500+ values.

Split under the one-key rule from geertruidenberg: this letter is in a different code from Torcy's letter (R8755), which keeps the old entry; files villars_ct.txt, villars_groups.txt and the DOC transcription moved here; length re-measured (173 groups, 106 distinct).

outcome.method_basis: No key in Add MS 61575, on DECODE or in Tomokiyo's tables fits; 173 groups are too few for a ciphertext-only rebuild of a code of 500+ values.

gaps.detail: different code, no key found, too short for ciphertext-only

outcome.notes: DECODE R8756 metadata has sender and receiver reversed; the DOC transcription corrected (575 -> 515). Split on 14 Oct 2026 from geertruidenberg (Torcy, R8755, a different code).

credits.note: DECODE transcription of R8756, checked against the images
